Round 142 fails verification on one layout problem that the new English text caused. Every check that can run here was run in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` = `realVerified` = true.

**The failure: C-R142-01 (Medium)**
- **What happens:** at 1440 with a video clip selected, the Clip Gain message "A video clip has no Clip Gain — for its sound use the track Volume/Mute" wraps onto 2 lines, with "Volume/Mute" alone on the second. The Georgian original fit on 1 line, and the "Video clip · no waveform" text above it shifts 16 px right and 8 px up. The task counts both as a layout FAIL.
- **Why it is this round's fault:** I swapped the original Georgian strings back into the same live page. That reproduced B's baseline exactly, 0 px off in all five states, and the message fit on 1 line again.
- **Status:** A reported this as a stop item and B hasn't ruled on it. Per the task's §8 outcome table, it goes to a small fix-up round. A measured shorter wordings that fit on 1 line; they're in A's evidence folder as data for B.

**Everything else passed:**
- **Tests and scope:** A's 82 test files pass 1294/1294, the same as A reported. Only the 22 permitted files changed, and no source changed while I was testing. The source diff matches the task: strings were only added, and no classes or test ids changed.
- **Panel text and messages:** every panel label and message matches the task's English exactly at both sizes (42 checks each), including the minus and ellipsis characters. The only Georgian left in the panel is the selected clip's own title, which is allowed for now.
- **Real audio:** I set Clip Gain to −20 dB and measured the output during playback. Volume dropped by 20.04, 20.00 and 20.04 dB in three runs, and Reset brought it back within 0.03 dB.
- **Library:** the folders read Music 2 / SFX 2 / Music 1 / Stems 4, and the row labels read Music / Stem / SFX. Searching `music` or `MUSIC` finds the 3 music sounds and `stem` finds the 4 stems. `მუსიკა` finds nothing, and clearing the search restores all 9. Adding a sound with Enter still works.
- **No Georgian left in this round's areas,** after the allowed exceptions (sound titles, collection names, the demo badge, the library's own text, the video area and the page title). The group and track areas from round 141 also have none.
- **Round 141 regression:** Ctrl+G still creates `Group “Group 1” created: Music, Stems.` and track labels are unchanged.
- **Premium access is not bypassed:** `/studio-lab` opens the demo without credentials, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio, and the studio token request returns 401. The fake-token 403 check is blocked because the backend isn't available in the cloud.
- **Network and console:** no forbidden requests, no Authorization headers, no hydration errors and no page errors in any session.

**Two Low findings:**
- **C-R142-02:** searching `stems` returns nothing, although the folder the user sees is called "Stems". Search matches the singular label "Stem", so the task's claim that `stems` would match doesn't hold. The Georgian version had the same gap, so it isn't a regression.
- **C-R142-03:** at 1280 with the panel open, the bottom line of the panel content is cut off. The Georgian swap gives exactly the same result, so it predates this round. B's baseline had no open panel at 1280, so I've marked that part of the layout check inconclusive rather than passed.

**Notes for B:** the Georgian "— დაკეცვა/გაშლა" suffix the task attributes to a folder button is on the collection button, for example `სინთეზური დემო · ღამის პულსი — დაკეცვა`. Folders have no such button. The link to Ableton is unconfirmed for both behaviours, because the relevant manual chapters were never captured.

Two of my early runs failed because of my own test script, not the product; both are recorded as invalid runs. I made no changes to the app or the repository.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop:
- c-round-142.md
- c-round-142.json
- c-round-142/ (scripts, measurements, screenshots)
